title: On Declaring the house open to all
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：declare　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 declare 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the warden ① declared the house open to all year after year, and every resident in the centre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the warden ② declares the house open to all for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ declare the house open to all at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ declared the house open to all before — a line in the register for June 1978 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Declaring the house open to all year after year, the warden said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ declare the whole sum at the gate for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Declare the whole sum at the gate at once and never mention it again.

By 1991 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new resident from the next centre ⑧ declares the whole sum at the gate year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ declared the house open to all again when nobody else would.

⑩ To declare the house open to all, my mother said in 1996, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the centre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the centre forgets, somebody declares the house open to all for the whole place again and somebody must declare the house open to all year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 宣布（一般过去式 declared the house open to all：1984 年管理员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 宣布（一般现在 declares the house open to all：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 宣布（不定式 to declare the house open to all：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 宣布（过去完成时 had declared the house open to all：1978 年六月的登记册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 宣布（动名词 declaring the house open to all 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 申报（declare the whole sum at the gate：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去申报在关口把整笔数额申报清楚）
G. v. 申报（declare the whole sum at the gate：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 宣布（后段两处：新来的居民照例 declares the whole sum at the gate，而母亲又一次 declared the house open to all）

answers.why: declare 意为“宣布”，1984 年管理员年年地宣布宣布这宅子人人可进，那是社区中心里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 declared。
declare 意为“宣布”，自那以后管理员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 declares。
declare 意为“宣布”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯宣布宣布这宅子人人可进”，此处为不定式 to declare the house open to all。
declare 意为“宣布”，登记册里 六月 那行字说明早在 1991 年之前就有人宣布过，故用过去完成时 had declared。
declare 意为“宣布”，管理员说“宣布宣布这宅子人人可进这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 declaring the house open to all 作主语。
declare 意为“申报”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去申报在关口把整笔数额申报清楚”，should ever 之后用原形 declare the whole sum at the gate。
declare 意为“申报”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻申报在关口把整笔数额申报清楚（declare the whole sum at the gate at once），以后再也不要提起。
declare 意为“宣布”，新来的居民每个月份都照例申报在关口把整笔数额申报清楚，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 declares。
declare 意为“宣布”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地宣布宣布这宅子人人可进，用一般过去式 declared 叙述。
declare 意为“宣布”，结尾那句是母亲 1996 年的话：要宣布宣布这宅子人人可进，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和社区中心记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 declare 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the warden declared the house open to all year after year, and nobody in the centre forgot it.
Even now the warden declares the house open to all for the whole place whenever the centre asks.
Declaring the house open to all year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever declare the whole sum at the gate for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new resident from the next centre declares the whole sum at the gate year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother declared the house open to all again, and the centre remembered that half.
